entries.name: p_HeroController_CountHeldSkills
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by HeroController_AddSkill; counts non-null entries across the 10 held skill slots hero+0x1020..0x1140 (stride 0x20).

entries.name: p_HeroController_RefreshSkillSlotStates
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by HeroController_AddSkill and HeroController_RemoveSkill; resolves hero level (hero+0x2f8+0xa94 or XpComponent via 0x1402dd800), finds first empty slot among 10 held slots (hero+0x1020), and dispatches bool signals on slot UI +0x348 (isFirstEmpty) and +0x368 (slot < level) via 0x1402af350.

entries.name: p_HeroController_RecountSkillTiers
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by HeroController_AddSkill and HeroController_RemoveSkill; zeros rarity counts at hero+0x11a0..0x11ac, iterates the 10 held skill slots (hero+0x1020), tallies **(uint**)(ctrl+0x68) for tiers 0..3, and mirrors tiers to *(hero+0x1dc0)+0x18+slot*4.

entries.name: p_HeroController_RecountSkillCategories
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by HeroController_AddSkill and HeroController_RemoveSkill; zeros category counts at hero+0x1230..0x1248, iterates the 10 held skill slots (hero+0x1020), and tallies matching category ids in settings+0x408 (count +0x410).

entries.name: p_SkillController_ApplyTierSignals
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by SkillController_SetTier and oCDtEntityCpntSkillController::vf28; dispatches tier-change channel ctrl+0x108 (0x14026ece0) and activates exactly one tier signal ctrl+0x128/+0x148/+0x168/+0x188 for tier 0..3 via 0x1402af350.

entries.name: p_GuidVector_InsertUnique
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by HeroController_AddSkill on magicalObjectComp+0x1d*8 with settings+0x88 (16-byte identity GUID); scans 16-byte pairs and appends via 0x14014e1e0 if absent.

entries.name: p_GuidVector_Remove
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by HeroController_RemoveSkill on magicalObjectComp+0x1d*8 with settings+0x88 (16-byte identity GUID); finds matching 16-byte entry, shifts remaining entries down, decrements count, returns 1 if removed.

entries.name: p_HeroController_SetState
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by HeroStats_OnDamageTaken and hero handlers; switches on state 0 (EntityComponent_Activate hero+0x300), 1 (deactivate hero+0x300 via 0x140711ab0), 2 (teardown 0x1403abfd0/0x1403aa7d0 and branch on hero+0xd80).

entries.name: p_HeroController_SetActiveTarget
entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called by NamedEvent_HeroUnsubscribeAll and hero handlers; swaps hero+0x1758, deactivating old target+0x138 via 0x140711ab0 and unsubscribing LAB_14040b5b0 via 0x14051bfe0, then activating new target via EntityComponent_Activate and subscribing LAB_14040b5b0.

entries.note: [proposed hero/skills] Called exclusively by GroupLevelComponent_Ctor and oCDtEntityCpntGroupLevel::vf8; allocates 8 bytes initialized to 1 (level=1, xp=0).

entries.name: p_XpComponent_GetXpForCurrentLevel
